source: Polymathic cross-domain mechanism import. Doctrine: RIG-COLLIDER — import mechanisms from unrelated domains; validity bar SIS-style transfer score >= 0.60 across 3+ domains. A mechanism is only 'imported' when the TARGET system's structure is named, not just the source metaphor.

mechanisms: thermodynamic entropy -> information debt accumulates in codebases
least action -> systems follow the minimum-energy path; design for it or against it deliberately
phase transitions -> gradual change then sudden reorganization; watch the control parameter
critical slowing down -> recovery from perturbation slows before regime shift (early-warning signal)
symmetry breaking -> small early asymmetries lock in structure (standards, defaults, first hires)
dissipative structures -> stability through throughput, not through stillness
renormalization group -> which details wash out at scale and which structure persists
evolutionary selection -> ship variants to a real selector; retain what survives contact
immune system -> dual fast (innate) + slow (adaptive, memory-building) defense; antigens = incidents
Red Queen -> constant running to stay in place; co-evolving competitors erode static advantage
ecological niches -> define the niche before competing in it; empty niches invite colonization
symbiosis gradients -> competition -> commensalism -> mutualism; move relationships along it
homeostasis vs allostasis -> setpoint-fixed vs predictive regulation; predictive beats reactive under volatility
punctuated equilibrium -> long stability, rapid speciation after isolation events
horizontal gene transfer -> borrow proven genes (tools/patterns) across species (companies), faster than evolving them
incentive gradients -> agents follow measured incentives, not stated goals
path dependence + lock-in -> early choices constrain later option space; QWERTY dynamics
moral hazard -> separated risk-bearer and decision-maker mutates behavior
signaling vs substance -> costly signals are credible; cheap talk is not
Schumpeterian creative destruction -> efficiency gains arrive via replacement, not improvement
Veblen goods -> demand rises with price for identity goods; positioning can be the product
marginal vs average -> decisions live at the margin; dashboards report averages
eigenvector centrality -> influence concentrates where flows converge
positive matrices (Perron-Frobenius) -> connected reinforcing structure has ONE dominant growth mode; find it
convexity -> prefer payoffs convex in uncertainty over linear optimization
Markov chains -> memorylessness: structure of states beats history; design transitions, not trajectories
phase-space portraits -> map all attractors, not just the intended one; the system will find the others
filtering/Kalman -> combine noisy signal + imperfect model weighted by their trust
graph spectral gap -> conductance governs how fast anything (info, failure, culture) spreads
control theory: feedback beats feedforward when disturbance is unmeasurable
gain margins -> systems oscillate when correction strength exceeds loop-delay tolerance
graceful degradation -> design failure to shed load, not to cascade
redundancy diversity -> N redundant copies of the SAME design fail together
stress -> strength interference -> reliability = distance between load distribution and capacity distribution
root-cause + leading indicators -> instrument the sensor, not the outcome
thermodynamic irreversibility -> some decisions cannot be un-made; size them before entry
prospect theory -> losses weighted ~2.25x; frame choices accordingly
implementation intentions -> if-then planning converts goals into behavior
cognitive load -> working memory is the bottleneck; structure beats willpower
identity-based habits -> behavior follows identity claims; change the identity, not the behavior
reactance -> threatened freedom increases resistance; preserve choice to lower it
social proof under uncertainty -> ambiguity amplifies copying; be the default or fight it
OODA loop -> decision tempo as a weapon; faster loop disorients the opponent
Schwerpunkt -> concentrate force at the decisive point, accept thinness elsewhere
defense-in-depth -> layered delaying actions trade space for time
indirect approach -> dislocate rather than confront (Liddell Hart)
mission command (Auftragstaktik) -> intent + boundaries, not step orders; enables tempo
center of gravity -> attack the source of power, not its manifestations
spaced repetition -> memory decays predictably; schedule reinforcement
deliberate practice -> edge-of-ability + immediate feedback + repetition
transfer through deep structure -> surface features don't transfer; principles do
interleaving -> mixed practice beats blocked for retention and discrimination
desirable difficulties -> retrieval effort strengthens memory; friction is the feature
power laws/heavy tails -> variance is structural, not error; plan for the tail
self-organized criticality -> systems drift to criticality; size the avalanche distribution
preferential attachment -> early winners compound connectivity
modularity -> containment of failure and parallel evolution both require module boundaries
diversity-value theorem -> diverse predictors beat accurate homogenous ones
Legible vs illegible (seeing-like-a-state) -> legibility enables control and destroys adaptation
first principles -> decompose to irreducibles; rebuild from there
epistemic humility -> separate certainty levels; label inference vs observation
pragmatic maxim -> meaning = practical effects; test concepts by their consequences
via negativa -> improvement by removal (Taleb); subtract before adding
steelmanning -> strongest form of the opposing view before deciding

steps: State the target problem's structure (from frame.md): the stock, the loop, the constraint.
Pick 3+ domains NOT native to the problem's field.
For each domain, list mechanisms whose source structure shares the target's shape (loop type, delay, stock).
For each candidate mechanism, write the IMPORT: 'in <target system>, <mechanism> implies <concrete intervention>'.
Score transfer validity: structural-similarity 0-1, mechanism-clarity 0-1, testability 0-1; keep candidates with product >= 0.60.
Keep the top 3 imports; each must name a measurable change in the target system.
Mark metaphor-only imports (no measurable change) as REJECTED with reason.
protocol.output_contract: polymath.md with sections: '## Target structure', '## Candidate imports' (table: domain, mechanism, source structure, target implication, transfer score), '## Top imports', '## Rejected (metaphor-only)'
